**About The Company**
 Instacart is revolutionizing the grocery industry by providing an innovative and reliable platform that connects customers with their favorite local stores. Our mission is to make grocery shopping accessible, convenient, and enjoyable for everyone. We believe that food is more than just sustenance; it's a way to bring people together, share love, and create lasting memories. By leveraging cutting\-edge technology and a customer\-centric approach, we aim to serve the diverse needs of our community, ensuring that everyone has access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Instacart has become a vital service for millions, offering flexible earning opportunities for our Personal Shoppers while maintaining high standards of safety and service quality. We are committed to transforming the grocery experience through innovation, inclusivity, and a focus on community engagement.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a talented and motivated Machine Learning Engineer to join our Logistics AI group at Instacart. In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers and product leaders to develop, implement, and refine machine learning solutions that enhance our core operations. Your primary focus will be on optimizing critical areas such as routing, pricing, dispatch, and mapping, directly impacting the efficiency and reliability of our services. You will be involved in all phases of the machine learning lifecycle—from initial concept and prototyping to experimentation and final deployment. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a fast\-paced, innovative environment where your work will have a tangible impact on millions of users. You will be part of a collaborative team dedicated to solving complex problems and pushing the boundaries of what is possible with AI and machine learning in the logistics domain.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To succeed in this role, candidates should possess a strong background in machine learning, data science, or related fields. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline is required, with a preference for candidates holding a master’s or Ph.D. degree. Proven experience in developing machine learning models, especially in areas such as routing, optimization, or predictive analytics, is essential. Proficiency in programming languages like Python, along with experience using machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit\-learn, is expected. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and data processing tools (SQL, Spark) is highly desirable. Strong analytical skills, problem\-solving abilities, and the capacity to work collaboratively within a team are critical for this role. Prior experience in logistics, supply chain, or delivery services will be considered a plus.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Machine Learning Engineer at Instacart, your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Designing and developing machine learning models to optimize routing, dispatch, and pricing strategies.
* Collaborating with product teams and senior engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Conducting data analysis and feature engineering to improve model performance.
* Implementing scalable machine learning pipelines and ensuring their integration into production systems.
* Monitoring and maintaining deployed models, continuously refining them based on new data and feedback.
* Participating in experimentation and A/B testing to evaluate model effectiveness.
* Documenting methodologies, results, and best practices to foster knowledge sharing within the team.


**Benefits**
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well\-being and professional growth. Our benefits include competitive salary packages, health insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching. We also provide flexible work arrangements to promote work\-life balance, including options for remote work and in\-office collaboration. Employees have access to professional development programs, ongoing training, and opportunities for career advancement within the company. Additionally, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture that values innovation, teamwork, and community engagement. Our employees enjoy various wellness programs, paid time off, and employee discounts, all aimed at creating a supportive and motivating work environment.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Instacart is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.  We are seeking an AI Performance Optimization Engineer to focus on extracting maximum throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing cost across training and inference workloads for large neural network systems. * Hands\-on experience optimizing deep learning workloads on modern GPUs
* Deep understanding of distributed training and inference techniques
* Experience with profiling tools across CPU, GPU, and distributed systems
* Familiarity with model compression techniques and their accuracy implications
* Strong grasp of memory hierarchies, communication primitives, and parallelism strategies
* Excellent measurement, debugging, and analytical reasoning skills
* Strong communication and collaboration skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience optimizing LLM inference at production scale
* Contributions to vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, DeepSpeed, or similar projects

 As a software engineer for SWIVEL, you will take on a prominent role within our Agile delivery teams. You will have the opportunity to build awesome technology to solve complex problems as well as mentor other developers. We look forward to welcoming you as the newest Swiviler on our growing team.

* Builds systems to interface with SWIVEL clientele.

* Guides and mentor’s junior and mid\-level developers on the team.

title: Integration Project Engineer
reason: Stack +12; Title fit +6; US +10; H1B +8
description_preview:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.
   

  

**Make a meaningful impact by creating bridges that improve healthcare.**
 For healthcare providers to make informed decisions and deliver the highest\-quality patient care, they depend on data from niche systems across hundreds of specializations. Epic's Integration Project Engineers architect information flow across disparate systems. Each project presents a new set of challenges and opportunities. If you seek variety in your work, you'll find it as an Integration Project Engineer
   

  

 Travel across the US (and potentially abroad) as a critical member of our implementation team and ensure the early success of new Epic community members. Once you're trained up, both Epic and customer teams will look to you to advise their implementation strategy, architecture, and project management.
   

  

**Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet**
 The top\-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.
   

  

**Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.**
 Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).
   

  

**More than just important work** 
 .
   

  

 Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant\-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four\-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.
   

  

 We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit\-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non\-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.
   

  

* Bachelor's or greater in engineering, math, information systems, or a related field
* A history of academic and professional success
* Strong analytical and reasoning skills
* Willingness to travel 25\-60% of working days, with a typical month including 1\-2 trips lasting 2\-4 days
* Eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship
* Relocation to the Madison, WI area (reimbursed)
* COVID\-19 vaccination

 Branchville, NJ (Short Hills, NJ from October)
 



 Onsite (5 Days a week)
 



 Contract
